script.title: MY FIRST PARALLEL PARK
script.story_hook: A nervous student parallel parks on a quiet street.
script.intro_zh: 學員第一次在馬路上練平行停車。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back! Today is a very first driving lesson.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來！今天是一堂初次駕駛課。
script.outro: That's the lesson for today! Practice often, stay safe.
script.outro_zh: 今天的課程就到這裡！多練習，注意安全。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat the driver's words together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們一起來跟讀駕駛時用的句子。
script.char_a_description: a teenage boy with curly ginger hair and a dusting of freckles, wearing an oversized college hoodie, keys on a red lanyard, both hands gripping the wheel at ten and two
script.char_b_description: a calm driving instructor in her forties with a silver-streaked bob, tan cardigan, sunglasses pushed up on her head, a folded route chart on her lap
script.youtube_title: 【🚗學英文】第一次平行停車好緊張？「你做得到的」超暖鼓勵句一次聽會🅿️💪鏡點倒車全教懂｜聽完就會用｜Parallel Parking English
script.youtube_title_en: “You've Got This” — A First Parallel-Parking Attempt
script.youtube_description:
第一次路邊停車，手都在抖？這堂溫柔駕駛課用 18 句美式日常英語，教你聽懂方向盤、後視鏡、倒車每個指令，也學會給自己打氣。附繁體中文與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完不再害怕上路。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Shaking hands on your first parallel park? This gentle driving lesson teaches every instruction you'll hear — wheel, mirrors, reverse — plus warm encouragement, in 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat each line in the second half and lose the fear of the road.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🚗學車停車英文｜鏡點對齊・倒車調整・打氣鼓勵｜聽完就敢上路｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
第一次路邊平行停車，聽到指令腦袋一片空白？
擦到路緣的那一刻，到底該說什麼、做什麼？

這一集帶大家走進一堂駕駛課的副駕座位，跟著學員從對齊後視鏡、打方向盤、倒車修正，到終於停進車位，全程都是自然的駕駛課英語。

你會聽到：
🪞 聽懂停車指令：例如 “Match mirrors, then turn the wheel right.”、“Straighten the wheel and creep in.”。
🔄 修正與確認：例如 “Ease off the gas, check your mirror.”、“Is my angle better now?”。
💪 鼓勵與道謝：例如 “You've got this.”、“Thanks for not taking over.”。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次換你坐進駕駛座，記得慢慢來——你做得到的！
script.scene: learner car on a quiet street
script.thumbnail_action: gripping a steering wheel while backing up

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, my first real parallel park — wish me luck.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ maɪ fɜrst riəl ˈpɛr·ə·ləl pɑrk wɪʃ mi lʌk/
dialogue.zh: 好，我第一次真的平行停車——祝我好運。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You've got this. Slow is always better here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊv ɡɑt ðɪs sloʊ ɪz ˈɔl·weɪz ˈbɛ·tər hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你做得到的。在這裡慢就是好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I pull up beside the car in front?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ pʊl ʌp bɪˈsaɪd ðə kɑr ɪn frʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 所以我先開到前面那台車旁邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. Match mirrors, then turn the wheel right.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs mætʃ ˈmɪ·rərz ðɛn tɜrn ðə wiːl raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，後視鏡對齊，然後右打方向盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? Oh — I'm getting too close.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs oʊ aɪm ˈɡɛ·tɪŋ tu kloʊs/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ease off the gas, check your right mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /iːz ɑf ðə ɡæs tʃɛk jɔr raɪt ˈmɪ·rər/
dialogue.zh: 鬆開油門，看你的右邊後視鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I touched the curb, didn't I? I knew it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tʌtʃt ðə kɜrb ˈdɪ·dən taɪ aɪ njuː dɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我碰到路緣了，對吧？我就知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a tap, no damage. Fix it in reverse.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə tæp noʊ ˈdæ·mɪdʒ fɪks ɪt rɪˈvɜrs/
dialogue.zh: 輕輕碰到而已，沒有損害。倒車調整一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Backing up… okay, is my angle better now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbæk·ɪŋ ʌp oʊˈkeɪ ɪz maɪ ˈæŋ·ɡəl ˈbɛ·tər naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 在倒了……好，現在角度比較好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much. Now straighten the wheel and creep in.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌtʃ naʊ ˈstreɪ·tən ðə wiːl ənd kriːp ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好多了。現在回正方向盤，慢慢倒進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I straight? This feels impossible, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ streɪt ðɪs fiːlz ɪmˈpɑ·sə·bəl ˈɑ·nəst·li/
dialogue.zh: 我停正了嗎？老實說這感覺不可能。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look ahead — you're a hand's width from the curb.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk əˈhɛd jʊr ə hænds wɪtʃ frʌm ðə kɜrb/
dialogue.zh: 看前面——你離路緣只有一個手掌寬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, I actually did it? No scratches?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt aɪ ˈæk·tʃu·ə·li dɪd ɪt noʊ ˈskrætʃ·ɪz/
dialogue.zh: 等等，我真的做到了？沒有刮傷？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean park! See? You just needed reference points.
dialogue.phonetic: /kliːn pɑrk siː ju dʒʌst ˈni·dɪd ˈrɛ·fərəns pɔɪnts/
dialogue.zh: 停得很漂亮！看到了吧？你只是需要參考點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, that mirror trick really does work.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðæt ˈmɪ·rər trɪk ˈrɪ·li dʌz wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那個後視鏡技巧真的有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the other side now, same steps.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ði ˈʌ·ðər saɪd naʊ seɪm stɛps/
dialogue.zh: 現在換另一邊試試，步驟一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, let's. Thanks for not taking over.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs lɛts θæŋks fər nɑt ˈteɪ·kɪŋ ˈoʊ·vər/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，謝謝你沒有直接接手開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime! You're up — take your time.
dialogue.zh: 隨時都行！換你了——慢慢來。
